sections.heading: Pub Charity
sections.lede: Rosehill College would like to sincerely thank Pub Charity for their generous support of our school through recent funding grants.

sections.html:
Their contribution has enabled the development of a concrete-based volleyball court, providing students with a safe, durable, and high-quality space for physical activity and sport. This new facility supports student wellbeing, encourages participation, and enhances opportunities for both recreation and competitive play.

Pub Charity has also approved funding for projectors in classrooms, helping to strengthen teaching and learning across the school. These upgrades support more engaging and interactive lessons, benefiting students across a wide range of subjects.

We are extremely grateful for Pub Charity’s ongoing support and commitment to improving educational and sporting opportunities for our students.
